title: MHADA Pune lottery 2026 (20% scheme): homes in Lohegaon, Kharadi, Keshav Nagar-Mundhwa and Dhanori, from MHADA's own list; apply by 22 October
audience: Marathi families in east Pune (Lohegaon, Kharadi, Keshav Nagar, Mundhwa, Dhanori, Viman Nagar) with family income up to 9 lakh, first home, 22-45
message: MHADA's own list for this Pune lottery has homes in our areas: Lohegaon 117 homes from 21.70 lakh, Kharadi 13.89 lakh, Keshav Nagar-Mundhwa 37 homes from 16.79 lakh, Dhanori 65 homes from 13.91 lakh; apply only on MHADA's site by 22 October.
facts: The MHADA Pune board lottery PB-26-Aug, 20 percent scheme, lists 168 schemes with 4,462 homes; application and payment from 24 August to 22 October 2026. Source: MHADA's lottery portal housing.mhada.gov.in, View Live Schemes, Pune board lottery PB-26-Aug 20 Percent, read 18 October 2026.

Lohegaon: 117 homes in 4 schemes - Prasun Elara 2 BHK (42 homes, 28.46 to 29.15 lakh), Maitri Meadows 2 BHK (69 homes, 28.88 to 29.07 lakh), Mindspace Residency Phase 1, 1 BHK (5 homes, 21.70 to 23.64 lakh) and 2 BHK (1 home, 25.46 to 27.61 lakh). Source: MHADA's lottery portal housing.mhada.gov.in, View Live Schemes, Pune board lottery PB-26-Aug 20 Percent, read 18 October 2026.
Kharadi: Zen Elite 1 BHK, 3 homes, 13.89 to 15.40 lakh. Source: MHADA's lottery portal housing.mhada.gov.in, View Live Schemes, Pune board lottery PB-26-Aug 20 Percent, read 18 October 2026.

Keshav Nagar and Mundhwa: 37 homes - Amara Keshavnagar 2 BHK (15 homes, 26.92 to 28.17 lakh), Atulyam Inclusive Housing 1 BHK EWS (7 homes, 16.79 to 16.84 lakh), 1 BHK (3 homes, 19.81 lakh) and 1.5 BHK (12 homes, 23.62 to 24.30 lakh). Source: MHADA's lottery portal housing.mhada.gov.in, View Live Schemes, Pune board lottery PB-26-Aug 20 Percent, read 18 October 2026.

Dhanori: 65 homes - Nyati Era II 1 BHK (12 homes, 18.06 lakh), Aaiji Crystal Phase 1 2 BHK (3 homes, 20.84 to 21.30 lakh), One Aretha Phase I 2 BHK (28 homes, 24.50 to 28.19 lakh), Kohinoor Viva Pixel Phase II 1 RK (7 homes, 13.91 lakh) and 1 BHK (15 homes, 20.29 lakh). Source: MHADA's lottery portal housing.mhada.gov.in, View Live Schemes, Pune board lottery PB-26-Aug 20 Percent, read 18 October 2026.
No scheme in Wagholi or Viman Nagar is in this list.
The last date to apply and pay the deposit online is 22 October 2026, 11:59 pm. Source: the notice on MHADA's lottery portal.
Applications are made only on MHADA's official site; MHADA's portal says it has appointed no agent and nobody should be paid in MHADA's name.

reply_facts: MHADA's own list for the Pune lottery (PB-26-Aug, 20 percent scheme, 168 schemes, 4,462 homes, read on housing.mhada.gov.in on 18 October 2026) has, in our areas: Lohegaon 117 homes - Prasun Elara 2 BHK (42 homes, 28.46 to 29.15 lakh), Maitri Meadows 2 BHK (69 homes, 28.88 to 29.07 lakh), Mindspace Residency Phase 1, 1 BHK (5 homes, 21.70 to 23.64 lakh) and 2 BHK (1 home, 25.46 to 27.61 lakh).

Kharadi: Zen Elite 1 BHK (3 homes, 13.89 to 15.40 lakh). Keshav Nagar / Mundhwa, 37 homes: Amara Keshavnagar 2 BHK (15 homes, 26.92 to 28.17 lakh), Atulyam Inclusive Housing 1 BHK EWS (7 homes, 16.79 to 16.84 lakh), 1 BHK (3 homes, 19.81 lakh), 1.5 BHK (12 homes, 23.62 to 24.30 lakh).

Dhanori, 65 homes: Nyati Era II 1 BHK (12 homes, 18.06 lakh), Aaiji Crystal Phase 1 2 BHK (3 homes, 20.84 to 21.30 lakh), One Aretha Phase I 2 BHK (28 homes, 24.50 to 28.19 lakh), Kohinoor Viva Pixel Phase II 1 RK (7 homes, 13.91 lakh) and 1 BHK (15 homes, 20.29 lakh). No scheme in Wagholi or Viman Nagar is in this list.

Other areas also have homes, for example Hadapsar (93 homes, 16.73 to 25.75 lakh) and Charholi (54 homes, 18.08 to 28.36 lakh); every scheme with its photo, carpet area and price is under 'View Live Schemes' on MHADA's official site.
The last date to apply and pay the deposit online is 22 October 2026, 11:59 pm; RTGS/NEFT payment by 23 October 2026, 3:59 pm. The draw is planned for 4 December 2026.
Family income limits: EWS up to 6 lakh a year, LIG 6 to 9 lakh (applicant plus spouse). Deposit (EMD): 15,000 for EWS, 20,000 for LIG, plus the 708 application fee.
Applications are made only on MHADA's official site; MHADA has appointed no agent; Avasetu does not take applications or money and cannot improve anyone's chances in the draw.
The pictures in the reel are screenshots of MHADA's lottery portal.

reply_faq.q: Is there a MHADA home in Wagholi?
reply_faq.a: MHADA's own list for this lottery has no scheme in Wagholi. Nearby Lohegaon (117 homes), Dhanori (65 homes) and Keshav Nagar-Mundhwa (37 homes) have homes; every scheme is under 'View Live Schemes' on MHADA's official site.

reply_faq.q: Lohegaon madhe MHADA ghar aahe ka, which projects in Lohegaon, price?
reply_faq.a: Yes: 117 homes in MHADA's list - Prasun Elara 2 BHK (42 homes, 28.46 to 29.15 lakh), Maitri Meadows 2 BHK (69 homes, 28.88 to 29.07 lakh), Mindspace Residency Phase 1 (1 BHK 21.70 to 23.64 lakh, 2 BHK 25.46 to 27.61 lakh).

reply_faq.q: Kharadi or Keshav Nagar or Mundhwa or Dhanori MHADA homes, which projects, price?
reply_faq.a: From MHADA's list: Kharadi - Zen Elite 1 BHK (3 homes, 13.89 to 15.40 lakh); Keshav Nagar/Mundhwa - Amara 2 BHK (15 homes, 26.92 to 28.17 lakh), Atulyam (1 BHK EWS from 16.79 lakh, 1.5 BHK 23.62 to 24.30 lakh); Dhanori - Nyati Era II (1 BHK 18.06 lakh), One Aretha (2 BHK 24.50 to 28.19 lakh), Kohinoor Viva Pixel (1 RK 13.91 lakh, 1 BHK 20.29 lakh), Aaiji Crystal (2 BHK 20.84 to 21.30 lakh).

reply_faq.q: Can I choose which project or area I apply for?
reply_faq.a: Yes, on MHADA's official site you pick the scheme (project and flat type) when you apply, and you pay that scheme's deposit. The draw is held scheme by scheme.

reply_faq.q: When is the last date and the draw?
reply_faq.a: Apply and pay the deposit online by 22 October 2026, 11:59 pm (RTGS/NEFT by 23 October, 3:59 pm). The draw is planned for 4 December 2026.

reply_faq.a: The pictures are screenshots of MHADA's lottery portal, where each scheme shows its own photo, carpet area and price under 'View Live Schemes'.
